summary: Coaches Corner is one hub: the Run Book first, then schedules, rules and the Rulebook app. Why: a coach finds every link without hunting.
blurb: One place for coaches: the run book first, then schedules, rules and getting cleared.

sources.fact: Spring volunteers get the background check emailed automatically by JDP and must also complete Abuse Awareness Training with the same email.
Abuse Awareness Training is required and valid for the year; use the email you registered to volunteer with.
The Little League Rulebook app is free on iOS and Android and covers baseball, softball and Challenger.

long_summary: Coach hub in one block with one action: the Run Book on a clipboard. Then the schedule tiles, BLS and District 10 rule PDFs plus a pitch-count link into the Run Book and the Rulebook app as the page's only outside button, a Get cleared tile into the Run Book and a Health & Safety tile. The clearance steps, gear bag note, Little League rules links and field layout cards are off the page; the All-Star PDF links through our portal path.
